fields.description:
Source: Kobi / Joyce doc feedback + annotated New Deal screenshots, 2026-08-10.

DEAL INFORMATION

• Deal Name\* — was free text only; now auto-fills from Market + Operator + Partner while untouched, with a 'Regenerate' link. (See BUILD-117 for the format + the clickable/formula question.)

• Deal Status\* — defaults to Active

• Operator\* — lookup, placeholder renamed to 'Search Operators...'

• Partner\* — lookup, placeholder renamed to 'Search Partners...'

• Market Country\* — picklist

• Market Province / State\* — picklist, DEPENDENT on Market Country. Helper: 'Dependent on Market Country. Market State is gone; this is the only region field.'

⚠️ 3 market fields collapse to 2. Market_State__c (the old combined one) is retired — see BUILD-101.

• Vertical\*

• Priority Tier\* — helper: 'Set here only — the deal list no longer shows a priority column.'

COMMERCIAL TERMS

• Payout Model\* — helper: 'Controls which commercial fields apply below.'

• Currency\* — defaults USD. Helper: 'Defaults to USD. CAD is the exception, set per book.'

• Deposit Range\* — Min / Max. Helper: 'Static values set on the deal.'

• Avg Deposit Target\* — numeric, default 0

• Monthly Cap\* — helper: 'Enter 0 if there is no cap — the field is numeric so reporting can measure against it.'

• Qualifying Action\* — text, placeholder 'e.g. First deposit + first settled bet'. Helper: 'Defines what the payout actually pays on.'

REDEPOSIT DETAILS

• Redeposit Required\* — defaults No. (Immediate Redeposit Range / Redeposit Type shown conditionally when Yes.)

ADDITIONAL DETAILS (NEW SECTION)

• Effective Start Date — MOVED HERE, defaults to today, editable when backdating

• Effective End Date

• Owner — MOVED HERE

• Deal Version — NOW READ-ONLY, incremented automatically. ⚠️ Note on the mockup: 'needs an edit log to exist first' — the version counter depends on a Deal edit-history/log mechanism that does not exist yet. Scope that or drop the auto-increment.

• Notes — MOVED HERE

Implementation: this is a record-type/page-layout + dynamic forms change. Conditional visibility driven by Payout Model and Redeposit Required.

Blocked by: BUILD-117 (name format), BUILD-101 (market field retirement).
fields.summary: BUILD-121 — Deal New/Edit modal layout rebuild (per 2026-08-10 screenshots)

comments.body: Closing the reviewed New/Edit modal work as Done for traceability. The current UX/lifecycle model is superseded by WAGR-485 and WAGR-450: new Deals default to New, Status is not directly editable, activation is a controlled action, and standard Salesforce Edit remains the default edit experience unless later requirements justify a dedicated Edit flow. Commercial Terms remains a separate workstream.
